steps.what: Photograph crime or accident scenes and verify evidential coverage

tasks.design: Retain scene photography with the officer using the camera equipment in {OTHER}. Existing {DOCS} storage supports preservation but earns no saving in taking evidential photographs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Framing, lighting, scale and scene coverage depend on conditions at the scene.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing digital cameras already capture images; their runtime is not new labour saving.
tasks.still_hard: An omitted view may become impossible to recover after the scene changes.
tasks.human_edge: Choose views that preserve spatial context and relevant detail without altering the evidence.
tasks.altitude: Scene attendance and photographic responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Specify evidence questions needing visual coverage
reach.learn: Connecting scene views to investigative questions

evidence.claim: Physical scene photography and coverage judgement are retained; no digest source establishes time savings for this capture task.

assumptions: Boundary is scene photographic capture and its immediate coverage check, not subsequent records maintenance under18708.

OTHER means camera equipment. Officer produces original images, case/scene identity, capture time, location/view context and scale reference during the retained100 hours. Missing context prompts manual clarification or another image before leaving; no pre-existing complete-coverage flag is assumed.
Retain native camera and storage functions before custom development; no image generation or evidence enhancement is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because equipment and workflow are unchanged.
research_questions: Which minutes are capture and which belong to separately counted records maintenance?

already_counted.description: Photography and immediate scene coverage verification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Scene attendance, framing and coverage verification retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain evidence records and prepare reports

steps.what: Verify evidence records and capture current custody and examination details
Copy verified evidence fields into record views and report headers
Write findings, review reports and approve evidence record updates

tasks.design: Configure the evidence records application in {OTHER} to reuse verified fields in {DOCS} report headers and record views. The officer retains first capture, interpretation, narrative findings and final record/report checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record and report templates may require repeated entry of the same factual fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mappings and templates can reuse data without generating evidential conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong item identity or incomplete custody information can propagate through every view.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve contradictions and state exactly what an examination supports.
tasks.altitude: Less copying may leave more time for source and custody checks; responsibility is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native record field reuse can remove duplicate copying; the saving is an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario, not a documented evidence-system case.

assumptions: OTHER means an evidence records application. Boundary is record maintenance and report preparation, excluding physical collection, image capture and evidence transfer. Roll-ups assign overlapping custody recording to one owner.

Officer produces case/item IDs, current container/seal identity, custody event time, sender/receiver, location, source record IDs/versions and examination references in s1's retained35 hours. Existing custodians produce their original event receipts as part of unchanged handling. Missing or conflicting values return to manual reconciliation before s2; no free verified-custody flag exists.
Test native templates and views before custom integration. Saving applies only to repeated copying, never original capture or existing system runtime.
Eight focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover mapping/version checks and exceptions; four other-role support hours are additional, not free transferred cleaning.
research_questions: Does native field reuse reduce duplicate copying without increasing source correction time?

already_counted.description: First capture, source verification, narrative and final checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact record update set, source versions, report text and attachments; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gross30 minus8 upkeep net22. Range0-10 allows already linked fields or mostly bespoke reports at0; modest duplicate copying supports the higher scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify evidence identity, submission requirements and authorised recipient
Submit evidence and confirm custody handover to the authorised recipient

tasks.design: Retain submission preparation and custody handover with the officer. Existing records in {OTHER} support identity checks, while {DOCS} holds the submission requirements and receipt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical custody and recipient-specific requirements cannot be resolved by automatic routing alone.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records already assist the task; no additional automation gain is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: A valid case number does not establish that the correct item and permitted recipient are present.
tasks.human_edge: Stop a handover when identity, packaging or authority is uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Submission responsibility and workload remain unchanged.

reach.task: Specify the purpose and scope of examination requests

evidence.claim: Evidence submission retains physical and procedural checks; no digest capability establishes savings in this task.

assumptions: OTHER means an evidence records application. Boundary is submission-specific preparation and handover, not routine records maintenance under18708. The same record capture is assigned once in roll-ups.

Case team and receiving authority supply the submission purpose, item request and current recipient requirements before s1. Officer verifies item IDs, seals, destination, permitted scope and relevant source versions in s1's40 hours and rechecks at s2. Receiving official produces the receipt during handover before the officer confirms completion. Missing authority or receipt uses manual escalation; no free ready-to-submit flag is assumed.
Retain native records and existing channels before custom routing. Recipient handling time remains outside and unchanged.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new process or transferred duty is proposed.
research_questions: Which submission preparation is already performed in the evidence records task?

approvals.approved_version: Exact items, seals, recipient, purpose and submission packet version at handover; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Physical transfer and submission-specific verification retain time; lab waiting is not labour saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Testify and present evidence in court

steps.what: Testify in court, present evidence and answer questions about its limits

tasks.design: Keep testimony and evidence presentation with the officer. Existing {DOCS} records can be consulted without substituting generated answers for personal knowledge.
tasks.previous_blocker: Testimony requires accountable answers to questions asked in the hearing.
tasks.enabler_now: No new enabler changes the hearing itself.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected questions can expose limitations or contradictions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what was observed, how it was established and what remains uncertain.
tasks.altitude: Court participation and evidential accountability are unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the limits of investigative evidence
reach.learn: Clear distinctions between fact and inference

evidence.claim: Court testimony and live questioning remain human work; a faster document tool does not establish a shorter hearing.

assumptions: Boundary is live testimony and presentation, excluding separately counted record/report preparation and submission.

Court officials produce the hearing request and questions, the latter during testimony before answers. Officer draws on personally verified findings and original records; no pre-produced reliable-answer flag is assumed. Uncertainty is stated rather than filled by extraction.
Existing record access remains unchanged; native access precedes any custom tool.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new tool or process is introduced.
unknowns: Extent of personal versus specialist testimony
research_questions: Are hearing minutes separated from separately counted preparation time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Live presentation and questioning retain their duration; no hearing-time saving is claimed.

role.altitude: Evidence record copying may shrink while photographic, submission and court responsibilities remain human.
reach: Learn investigative evidence needs with detectives
Learn source interpretation with intelligence analysts
role.ambitious_version: An officer who preserves evidence context from scene capture through records and courtroom explanation.
